verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-extraction API rather than an insights tool. Its closest feature to AI-generated suggestions is an endpoint that generates candidate extraction schemas for a file (datalab-docs-41). It also offers published agent processors run on documents (datalab-docs-40) and schema-driven AI extraction with citations (datalab-docs-3, datalab-docs-18). None of these surface insights or recommendations about the user's data, and the evidence does not show them inside the in-app Forge UI. missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of document contents, in-product (UI) suggestion surfaces, documentation of what agent processors produce, independent or hands-on corroboration.
